blocks.text: Observation collects data by watching subjects in their natural environment, without interfering. A restaurant wants to know which tables customers choose at lunchtime; a staff member records seating choices for one week, and the restaurant rearranges seating to improve comfort, customer flow and service.

blocks.prompt: Why might observation give better data than asking customers where they like to sit?
blocks.explanation: It records what people actually do, not what they say they do, and does not disturb their behaviour.

items: Observation: watch without interfering; e.g. a week of lunchtime seating choices.
